about: A note-taking app that can import notes from Evernote and Obsidian.

prs.title: Evernote notes with tasks keep their title and dates on import
prs.broken: When an Evernote note had tasks, each task's title and dates were glued onto the note's own, so the title got longer and the note lost its original dates.
prs.changed: The importer now reads the title and dates only from the note itself, not from the tasks inside it.
prs.matters: Notes moved over from Evernote look the same and stay in the right order by date.
